libraries.name: Dana Porter Library
libraries.hours_observation: Observed on libcal.uwaterloo.ca/hours for the week Sun 25 Oct - Sat 31 Oct 2026 (regular term hours). Hours vary by term and week; re-check the source.
hours_exceptions: Exam periods have historically had extended hours (older notices: Davis Centre 24 hours except Sunday 02:00-08:00; Dana Porter 08:00-02:00). No Fall 2026 exam-hours notice was found, so these are NOT confirmed for this term.
Spring 2025 hours were reduced (Dana Porter 22:00, Davis Centre 23:00 close) per Daily Bulletin 2025-04-08.
Holidays and reading weeks may differ; always check libcal.

live_occupancy.notes: Occuspace/Waitz people-counting sensors. Linked from the UW Library home page (lib.uwaterloo.ca/web: "Real-time occupancy: waitz.io/waterloo"). The JSON endpoint is undocumented/unofficial: no auth required and verified returning data on 2026-10-29, but it may change or be rate limited, so poll gently (e.g. every 2-5 min), fail soft to the estimate, and credit Waitz/Occuspace. Companion endpoint https://waitz.io/compare/waterloo gives trend text (peak hours, best floor).

typical_busyness_estimate.label: Estimate, not live
typical_busyness_estimate.description: Hand-built heuristic (not measured, not fitted to data). Value = typical relative busyness 0-1 for local hour of day (index 0 = 00:00-00:59). Final busyness = hour_by_weekday[day][hour] * term_week_multiplier, shown only when the library is open per weekly_hours; zero outside open hours. Show as Quiet <0.35, Moderate 0.35-0.7, Busy >0.7. If live_occupancy fetch succeeds, prefer it and use this only as fallback.

term_week_multiplier.description: Scale by week of a 13-week term (1-indexed); reading week and exam period are guesses.

typical_busyness_estimate.calibration_note: One live Waitz reading on Thu 2026-10-29 ~14:20 (week 8 of Fall term): Dana Porter 71%, Davis Centre 92%, Musagetes 27%. The heuristic gives 0.90*0.95=0.86 at Thursday 14:00, so it may overstate Dana Porter and understate Davis. Tune against more Waitz samples if logged.
